name: Berghotel Breitmoos
kurzbeschreibung:
**Mountain Lodge Breitmoos in Mittersill**

Nestled in the heart of the **Hohe Tauern** National Park, the **Berghotel Breitmoos** offers breathtaking views of the **Hohe Tauern** mountain range and the serene waters of **Mittersiller See**. Just a short stroll from the center of **Mittersill**, this charming alpine retreat combines rustic Tyrolean warmth with modern comforts.

Wake up to panoramic vistas of snow-capped peaks and crystal-clear lakes, then enjoy a hearty breakfast featuring local specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Speckknödel**, and homemade jams. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the **Zillertal** or **Pongau** valleys, unwind in the cozy **Stüberl** with a glass of **Tyrolean Grüner Veltliner** or a steaming cup of **Almrausch** tea.

The hotel’s family-run atmosphere makes every guest feel at home, while its prime location ensures easy access to **Tirol’s** and **Salzburg’s** most stunning outdoor adventures. Whether you’re seeking relaxation or thrill, **Berghotel Breitmoos** promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of the **Alps**.
